channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: 7 of 16 Trump Treasury officials quit: What’s behind the exodus?
item.description: According to NOTUS, seven of the 16 Treasury officials confirmed by the Senate since the beginning of Trump’s second term — about 44% — have either resigned or been forced out.

item.title: Quote of the Day by Sebastian Stan: ‘Embrace your differences and the qualities about you that you think are weird’
item.description: Sebastian Stan’s quote about embracing the qualities that make people different reflects a career built on taking risks, moving beyond familiar roles and finding strength in individuality.

item.title: Trump crackdown could take 200,000 immigrant truck drivers off the roads
item.description: Critics argue that the campaign is being driven less by public safety concerns and more by the administration’s broader mass deportation and “America First” agenda.

item.title: Delhi-Mumbai Expressway opens 9-km stretch for trial: Faridabad, Jaipur route details
item.description: Delhi-Mumbai Expressway's 9-km Delhi stretch begins trial runs, offering a new route to Faridabad and Jaipur while easing Mathura Road traffic.

item.title: CJP’s Saurav Das dismisses Mohandas Pai's ‘boring, unconnected to reality’ school inspection suggestion: ‘Much like…'
item.description: CJP leader Saurav Das rejected Aarin Capital Chairman Mohandas Pai's suggestions for school inspections, calling the approach ‘slow, boring, unconnected to reality’. He said NITI Aayog and NGOs are already conducting similar exercises.

item.title: India aims to establish space station by 2035, first Bharatiya Antariksha Station module approved: ISRO chief
item.description: India plans to establish its own space station, the Bharatiya Antariksha Station, by 2035, ISRO chief V Narayanan said. He added that the first module has already been approved, while the Gaganyaan mission is also in the pipeline.

item.title: Trump election moves spark fears of emergency powers to influence November vote: Report
item.description: The concerns come after a series of actions by the Trump administration that voting rights groups and election experts have viewed as attempts to increase federal influence over elections, according to the news report.

item.title: Zelenskyy Says Ukraine Had No Role in Nord Stream Pipeline Blast
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine played no role in the sabotage of the Nord Stream gas pipelines linking Russia to Europe, following the arrest in Croatia of a second Ukrainian suspect sought by Germany.

item.title: Ajit Doval to meet China's Foreign minister Wang Yi on 25 Aug after last year's SCO summit—Why is NSA visiting Beijing?
item.description: India's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval will meet Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Beijing on Tuesday. Doval and Wang last met in August 2025 on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Tianjin.

item.title: US visa bulletin September 2026: What Indian Green Card applicants need to know about EB-1, EB-2, EB-3, family visas
item.description: The bulletin sets the Final Action Dates and Dates for Filing for September, determining when immigrant visa applicants can move forward with their green card cases.

item.title: Sugar imports from Brazil may reach India before October 15 as Red Rot, El Niño hit domestic output
item.description: Sugar shipments from Brazil may reach India before October 15 as the Centre allows duty-free imports to ease supply pressures and curb prices.

item.title: Earthquake today: Magnitude 6.0 quake strikes Japan's Hokkaido hours after tremors injure over 40 in Tokyo
item.description: The epicentre was located off the coast of Urakawa in Hokkaido. The quake struck at a depth of 40 kilometres. However, no tsunami warning was issued.

item.title: Gautam Adani-DK Shivakumar meeting: 'He wanted to…' — says Karnataka CM | What transpired in hour-long discussion?
item.description: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani met Karnataka CM D K Shivakumar in Bengaluru for a meeting the CM described as a courtesy visit. The meeting came amid the proposed Hebbal-Silk Board tunnel road, for which Adani Enterprises is the lowest bidder.

item.title: Company slaps ₹23.93 lakh defamation suit against woman over one-star Google review: 'Malicious allegations'
item.description: The case centres on a public review that the company claims caused significant damage to its reputation and business.

item.title: India-Japan ties: Piyush Goyal leads largest-ever delegation; FICCI expects semiconductor, electronics MoUs
item.description: India and Japan aim to enhance cooperation in semiconductors and electronics, with MoUs expected to be signed during a business delegation visit led by Union Minister Piyush Goyal. Over 200 delegates will engage in business meetings and site visits to strengthen commercial ties.

item.title: Trump agreed to India’s ‘no questions’ request at G7, then ‘forgot’ and held 45-min presser with PM Modi: US envoy
item.description: Gor said he was with Trump before the US President met PM Modi and discussed what India was expected to raise during the meeting.

item.title: 'Represented India in three countries': Former diplomat Navdeep Suri asked to 'prove citizenship' during Punjab SIR
item.description: Former diplomat Navdeep Suri said he was asked to provide documents proving his Indian citizenship during Punjab's SIR exercise. Suri said he was asked for his passport after officials found discrepancies with 2003 electoral records.

item.title: No new H1N1 strain in circulation, vaccines remain effective: ICMR
item.description: The clarification comes against the backdrop of heightened review measures by the central government.

item.title: Iran discovers huge 7.5 trillion cubic feet gas reserve in Fars Province amid US sanctions pressure
item.description: Iran's pre-war natural gas production was estimated at around 650 million cubic metres per day, equivalent to approximately 8.4 trillion cubic feet annually. The recoverable gas from the newly discovered field therefore represents a substantial volume compared with Iran's annual production.

item.title: Iran-linked hackers shut down UK power plant for four days: Report
item.description: The UK government and the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) have not disclosed the identity of the site or details about the attack, citing security concerns.

item.title: FSSAI suspends Marche Retail's licence, restrains SDP Industries from selling 'Shraddha', 'Shree Saras' and 'Gokul' ghee
item.description: FSSAI has suspended Delhi-based Marche Retail's licence for 30 days over food safety violations and restrained Daman-based SDP Industries from selling Shraddha, Shree Saras and Gokul ghee after samples raised adulteration concerns.

item.title: Delhi Police told to control anger, avoid ‘villain’ tag during protests after CJP agitation: What fresh guidelines say
item.description: Delhi Police have been issued guidelines advising personnel to maintain professionalism, exercise restraint in protests, avoid provocations, and refrain from accepting items from protesters. It comes amid allegations of police excesses during the CJP protest at Jantar Mantar last month.

item.title: Kapil Dev, Sunil Gavaskar, Ian Chappell & Co urge Pakistan PM to ensure Imran Khan’s medical care; ‘Basic decency…’
item.description: The Supreme Court in Pakistan has ordered former PM and cricket captain Imran Khan to be shifted from Adiala Jail in Rawalpindi to Shifa International Hospital in Islamabad and be kept there until the next hearing on September 16. The authorities did not comply with Supreme Court's order.&nbsp;

item.title: Chinese humanoid robot beats Usain Bolt’s 100m world record — but with a chaotic finish | Video
item.description: A Chinese humanoid robot ran 100 metres in 9.39 seconds in a preliminary heat at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing on Saturday, faster than the men's world record held by Jamaican sprinting great Usain Bolt.

item.title: Pune property registration online: Step-by-step process to avoid police action
item.description: Pune residents can register leave and licence agreements online through the IGR portal. The process covers property and party details, agreement drafting, online payment, biometric verification and final registration with the sub-registrar’s office.

item.title: Front-of-pack labels for junk food: What the SC said and why it matters
item.description: Warning labels, which alert consumers to high sugar, salt, and fat content in ultra-processed foods, are yet to be implemented, though India began deliberations over a decade ago.

item.title: Panama-flagged cargo incident: 2 liferafts, oil slick detected, 2 rescued; search op on after it sank off Odisha coast
item.description: Panama-flagged cargo incident: 2 liferafts, oil slick detected, 2 rescued; search op on after it sank off Odisha coast

item.title: Centre moves SC against Madras HC relief to Jio in GST input credit case
item.description: The government seeks to overturn the order, which directed GST authorities to reconsider the show-cause notices issued to Jio.

item.title: India monsoon 13% below normal as strong El Niño raises risk of hotter summer in 2027: Report — What scientists say
item.description: India's monsoon may face disruptions due to a record-strength El Niño, potentially leading to an exceptionally hot summer in 2027. Current rainfall is 13% below normal. Studies examining period following strong El Niño events have reportedly indicated a higher likelihood of extreme heat.

item.title: Pregnant Defence Ministry officer found dead in Delhi; parents allege harassment by husband, in-laws
item.description: A 30-year-old Ministry of Defence ASO, Nazia Khanam, was found dead at her rented home in Delhi’s Dwarka on August 21. Her parents later alleged harassment by her husband and in-laws. Police registered an FIR and are investigating.

item.title: Harry and Meghan return to UK after 6 years: Why their $60 million fortune could face a tax hit
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are returning to the UK after six years in the US, but tax experts say the move could mean missing out on valuable tax breaks. Their estimated $60 million fortune could face greater UK tax exposure because they did not complete 10 years of non-residence.

item.title: He sold cars, now he’s a prince: How a 26-year-old became member of Belgium’s royal family
item.description: The legal recognition gives Clement Vandenkerckhove the status of Prince Laurent’s son and allows him to inherit from his father’s private estate alongside Laurent’s three other children — Princess Louise and twins Prince Nicolas and Prince Aymeric.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi a ‘Real Life Batman’? Posters put up near Congress HQs in Delhi hail him as ‘Watchful Protector’
item.description: Posters depicting Rahul Gandhi as 'real-life Batman' have appeared near Congress headquarters and central Delhi. Displayed by Youth Congress president Akshay Lakra, they include phrases like 'The Silent Guardian' and 'A Watchful Protector'.

item.title: NCP (SP) MLA Rohit Pawar’s PA's 15-year-old daughter found dead in Maharashtra's Baramati; probe underway
item.description: NCP (SP) MLA Rohit Pawar’s PA's 12-year-old daughter was found dead under suspicious circumstances in Baramati, Maharashtra. Police are investigating after the girl, who reportedly had a disagreement with her mother, went missing.&nbsp;

item.title: Subko apologises after Bengaluru customer alleges body-shaming: ‘Little fat black shirt’
item.description: The customer also stressed that body-shaming should not be viewed differently when the person being targeted is a man.
